title: Ice & Fire Cave
body:
The Ice & Fire Cave is located behind the waterfall on top of where you can enter the River Caves.

To access it, you need to travel up to the two rivers area where you find Dugg's Digging, follow down the streams, jump off the cliff of the warterfall onto a small edge.

Inside there are two small area connected whith each other, one is a fire area and the other one an ice. Both character are not interactable, and you can't pick up any of the items.

Trivia

The Console at the back of the cave was the way of opening the bridge to Ferwater Island when it was first added to the game.
